purpose: Explain the Show Project to AI tab, project-root scope safety, collector subprocess stages, complete JSON evidence generation, AI context bundle creation, and JSON ZIP handoff export.
display_lines: Project Structure Map builds local evidence about the selected project folder.
Run Collector creates a runtime trace, runs the static collector, enriches the complete JSON, and generates the AI context bundle.
Project root must be a real project folder; broad drive-root scans are blocked.
Output JSON is evidence for review and AI context, not a source-code edit.
Create Second Prompt Files runs JSON ZIP export automatically into the external Show Project to AI delivery folder.
